seed: The ruler's own gesture under a real pointer, at Next defaults with no flag set: a drag along the ruler away from the playhead draws a range (In and Out set, the playhead stays), a drag that starts on an end of the range moves that end, and a drag that starts on the playhead still scrubs.

steps.note: a real drag on the ruler from about 0:03 to 0:05, away from the playhead at 0:01: a green band with a grip at each end, washed down the tracks, and the playhead did not move
a drag that starts on the Out grip carries the Out alone to about 0:06, the In stays
a drag that starts on the playhead scrubs it, as the ruler always has, and the range is left as it was
